name: web-circular-ring-of-rotating-photo-cards-around-ai-headline
title: Ring of small rounded photo cards arranged in a circle around the centred line 'The future is built on AI.' and a scroll cue
whatItIs: A white page with about twenty small tilted rounded photos (mountains, lakes, forest, dusk skies) placed evenly around a large circle, and inside it a centred light headline 'The future is built on AI.' with a tiny 'SCROLL TO EXPLORE' line.
whatItMeans: Airy and kinetic; a ring of images frames a single line and hints at rotation.
techniques: Place photos evenly on a circle.
Tilt each tile along the ring.

vocabulary.definition: Each item rotated to follow the circle.
A small line inviting the user to scroll.
A headline inside a ring of images.
